option_relations.rationale: Systemic lupus erythematosus is a systemic autoimmune disease, but it is not directly related to Interstitial Lung Disease in a way that fits the defined relation types.
Antiphospholipid syndrome is a thrombophilic disorder, not directly related to Interstitial Lung Disease in a way that fits the defined relation types.
Dermatomyositis is an inflammatory myopathy, not directly related to Interstitial Lung Disease in a way that fits the defined relation types.

Antimelanoma differentiation associated gene 5 clinically amyopathic dermatomyositis is a specific subtype of dermatomyositis, not directly related to Interstitial Lung Disease in a way that fits the defined relation types.
